description: Use Hindsight for coordinator memory and isolate subnode memory hooks
changelog:
**Workflow fixes:**
- Subnode templates disable Hindsight hooks and MCP tools so evidence workers do not create or consume unsupervised memory.
- Coordinator-owned Hindsight handoff remains available for explicit project memory writes.
- The bundled handoff contract is aligned with the Hindsight-backed Pennix workflow.
notes: Run npm install -g @pennixrv/trellis@beta then trellis update. No --migrate required.
